behaviors.statement: A non-Burrower monster targets the nearest available target (living hero or hotspot with >=1 civilian), by straight-line distance; ties break to lowest entity id (Burrower exception: B-003)
A barricade blocking a non-Burrower monster's path to its target becomes the monster's attack target until destroyed
Burrowers always target the nearest hotspot with civilians and ignore barricades and heroes
A monster hit on a hotspot kills ceil(damage/10) civilians, clamped so the hotspot never goes below 0
The team loses exactly when total civilians across all hotspots reaches 0
Killing the last living monster of a wave completes the wave; completing the final wave wins the map
Each monster kill adds its bounty to the single shared team scrip pool
A placement purchase succeeds only during the planning phase, in a valid zone, with sufficient scrip; scrip is decremented on success
Unspent scrip carries over unchanged into the next wave's planning phase
The combat phase starts early when all connected players are ready, otherwise when the 60s planning timer expires
Rancher's lasso slows the struck monster's move speed by 50% for exactly 3.0 seconds, after which speed restores
Sawbones takes incoming damage reduced by a flat 30% (floor of reduced value applied)
A hero at 0 HP dies immediately and respawns at the team spawn point at full HP after exactly 10 seconds; dead heroes are not valid monster targets
During planning a placeable can be sold for floor(purchase_cost * 0.5) refunded to the shared pool, removing the entity

Kills grant the credited player (the killer; turret kills credit the placer) XP equal to the monster's bounty; lifetime XP never decreases; level L requires cumulative XP of 100*L*(L-1)/2, and crossing a threshold grants exactly one skill point per level gained
A skill point can be spent to unlock Q, unlock E, or rank up an unlocked ability (max rank 3), player's free choice; spending without a point is rejected
Profile changes (XP, level, skill allocations) are persisted server-side keyed by account id at each level-up and match end

Placeable combat effects: a spike trap deals 30 damage per monster crossing and breaks after 10 triggers; a dynamite trap deals 150 AoE damage exactly once then is removed; a turret damages the nearest living monster in range 8
Hero attacks never damage heroes or placeables (no friendly fire)
